findings.evidence: The exported signature the author quoted begins `∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {X G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [DiscreteTopology G] {π : TauCeti.freeProP p X →ₜ* G} …`, yet primality is used nowhere in lines 111-146, and `[DiscreteTopology G]` is used only through `isClosed_eq π.continuous continuous_const` (line 120), which needs `[T2Space G]`. The repo already states the analogous "normal generators span" fact for a general pro-`p` group, not a free one: `ProP/Relation/Module.lean:86` `span_completedGroupAlgebraModule_topologicalAbelianization_eq_top` takes `hG : IsProP p G`.
findings.fix: State it for `{F : Type*} [Group F] [TopologicalSpace F] [ContinuousMul F]`, `[T2Space G]` in place of `[DiscreteTopology G]`, a ring `R` in place of `ZMod p`, and an arbitrary `MonoidAlgebra R G`-module `M` in place of `X → MonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) G`; move the three helpers with it and let the free pro-`p` callers instantiate `F := freeProP p X`.
findings.issue: `mem_span_range_cocycle_of_map_eq_one` uses no property of `freeProP p X`, of `p` prime, or of the module being `X → 𝔽_p[G]`: the proof (lines 115-146) only needs a topological group, `π.continuous`, a Hausdorff target, `Subgroup.closure_induction`/`closure_minimal`, and a submodule closed under `single (π v) 1 • ·`. The private helpers at lines 86, 93, 99 are the same `IsCocycle₁`-level facts about an arbitrary group.

findings.evidence: Lines 160-195 reference `freeProP.of` only via `hDof` inside the `hcomp` computation; the underlying API is ring-general (`MonoidAlgebra.basis (R) (k) [Semiring k]` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Module.lean:191, and `relationModule` is stated over `[Ring R]` at TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/RelationModule/Basic.lean:58).
findings.fix: Generalize the domain to a topological group `F` with a family `u : X → F` and hypothesis `∀ i, D (u i) = Pi.single i 1`, concluding `relationModule R G (fun i ↦ π (u i)) ≤ span (MonoidAlgebra R G) (Set.range fun ρ : s ↦ D ρ)`; the `𝔽_p[G]^X` target must stay, but `freeProP` and `ZMod p` need not.
findings.issue: `relationModule_le_span` has the same over-specialized domain: the free generators enter only as the family `freeProP.of i` through `hDof`, and the proof uses no universal property of `freeProP p X` (only `hπ`, `hs`, `hD`, `hDof`, `MonoidAlgebra.basis`, `Fintype.linearCombination`).

summary: The recurrence and algebra forms sit at the natural level and the prior `hTS` redundancy is fixed, but the two public lemmas in `Relation/Cocycle.lean` carry a free pro-`p` domain, a prime `p` and a fixed coefficient field that their proofs never use.
